inspection.officer_note: Some beds under sheet; rest tidy.

correspondence.msg: Tenant says illness has slowed the digging.

deciding.cultivation_breach: Dormant season: 16 of 21 m2 cultivated or covered, about 76%, meets the standard. An approved medical exemption runs to 2024-11-09. Leaning false; the illness message is unverified and the area is only just above the line.
deciding.notice_ladder_met: The only warning has served_on null and reinspected_on null, so service and reinspection are missing. Clearly false.
deciding.next_action: The standard is met in the dormant season and the exemption is valid, with no hazards listed. no_action leads, with slight doubt from the unserved old warning.
deciding.recurrence_count: One earlier warning logged in September 2023, within 12 months, and nothing else. Level 1 leans, since the record shows little beyond that one entry.
deciding.uncultivated_extent: Uncultivated is 5 of 21 m2, about 24%, just under the 25% boundary between levels 0 and 1. The covered bed counts as cultivated in the dormant season.
